# Team Billing Subsystem — Work Breakdown

**Top deliverable:** Team Billing Subsystem (Q3 release scope)

## Explicit Gap (documented, not assigned)

**Multi-Currency Support** — deferred to a later release per leadership decision. All five pieces below assume **single-currency (USD) operation only** for this quarter. This gap line exists so the deferral is written down and doesn't silently reappear as "forgotten scope" — flag it to leadership/stakeholders as the source-of-truth record, since it currently exists nowhere else.

---

## 1.1 Billing Engine
- **Scope:** Calculate charges from usage data + pricing/plan rules; produce charge records; request charge execution from the Vault.
- **In:** Rating logic, plan/pricing rule evaluation, charge record creation.
- **Out:** Storing payment methods, generating invoice documents, capturing raw usage events, currency conversion.
- **Deliverable:** Charge calculation service + charge record data model.
- **Interfaces:** Consumes aggregated usage from Usage-Tracking Service; calls Vault's charge-execution API; emits charge records to Invoice Generator.
- **Acceptance:** Given usage + plan inputs, produces correct charge amount and a persisted, auditable charge record.
- **Size:** M
- **Owner:** TBD
- **Dependencies:** Usage-Tracking Service (data), Payment-Method Vault (execution)

## 1.2 Payment-Method Vault
- **Scope:** Securely store/manage tokenized payment methods; own the single integration point to the payment gateway for charge/refund execution (minimizes PCI scope).
- **In:** Add/update/remove payment methods, tokenization, gateway charge/refund calls.
- **Out:** Pricing/rating logic, invoice creation.
- **Deliverable:** Vault service with charge/refund API.
- **Interfaces:** Called by Billing Engine to execute charges; exposes read-only payment-method status to Admin Dashboard.
- **Acceptance:** Payment methods stored per PCI-relevant security requirements; charge requests from Billing Engine succeed/fail with clear status.
- **Size:** M
- **Owner:** TBD
- **Dependencies:** Payment gateway (external)

## 1.3 Invoice Generator
- **Scope:** Consume charge records and produce invoice documents (numbering, line items, delivery to customer).
- **In:** Invoice document generation, invoice numbering/history, delivery.
- **Out:** Charge calculation, payment method storage, usage collection, tax computation (flag: confirm with stakeholders whether tax logic belongs here or is out of scope — not specified).
- **Deliverable:** Invoice records + generated documents (PDF/HTML) + delivery mechanism.
- **Interfaces:** Consumes charge records from Billing Engine; exposes invoice data to Admin Dashboard.
- **Acceptance:** Every charge record produces exactly one correctly formatted invoice, deliverable and retrievable by invoice number.
- **Size:** S
- **Owner:** TBD
- **Dependencies:** Billing Engine

## 1.4 Usage-Tracking Service
- **Scope:** Ingest usage events from the product, aggregate per billing period, expose aggregates.
- **In:** Event ingestion, aggregation logic, exposure API.
- **Out:** Pricing/rating logic.
- **Deliverable:** Usage event store + aggregation API.
- **Interfaces:** Feeds aggregated usage to Billing Engine; exposes raw/aggregate usage to Admin Dashboard (read-only).
- **Acceptance:** Usage events are captured with no loss/duplication and aggregate correctly to the billing period boundary.
- **Size:** M
- **Owner:** TBD
- **Dependencies:** Product event sources (external)

## 1.5 Admin Dashboard
- **Scope:** Internal/admin UI for viewing bills, invoices, usage, and payment-method status. **Assumption:** this is an internal/support-facing tool, not a customer-facing billing portal — confirm with stakeholders, since the original request didn't specify.
- **In:** Read-only views composing data from the other four pieces.
- **Out:** Any write/mutation of billing logic, payment methods, or invoices; authentication/authorization infrastructure (assumed to reuse existing platform auth — flag as external dependency, not built here).
- **Deliverable:** Dashboard UI.
- **Interfaces:** Read-only consumer of Billing Engine, Invoice Generator, Usage-Tracking Service, and Vault (status only).
- **Acceptance:** Admin can view accurate, up-to-date bills/invoices/usage for any account without being able to alter billing state.
- **Size:** S
- **Owner:** TBD
- **Dependencies:** All four other pieces (read-only); existing platform auth (external)

---

## Coverage check
The five pieces + the documented multi-currency gap account for the full known scope of this quarter's Team Billing subsystem — no piece owns overlapping responsibility (Vault owns payment-method storage *and* the gateway integration point; Billing Engine owns pricing math only; Invoice Generator owns document/delivery only; Dashboard owns no data, only views).

**Open item to escalate:** confirm with leadership/product whether tax computation and whether the Admin Dashboard is internal-only — both are currently assumptions I made to keep the split non-overlapping.
